problem: Repository cleanup stayed red because nine historical GitHub Actions runs remained queued even after cancel, force-cancel and delete were rejected, while Outcome Obligation Sweep also failed on cancelled Production Release Readback sources that could not have trusted completion artifacts.
root_cause: The janitor coupled provider cleanup success to repository cleanup success: one uncancellable legacy run aborted the whole sweep before stale branch cleanup. Separately, the completion-evidence resolver did not gate workflow_run sources on conclusion=success before requiring source artifacts.
prevention: Uncancellable legacy Actions runs are quarantined as explicit CANCEL_RUN_BLOCKED evidence and may not abort deterministic cleanup of other repository debris.
The janitor must continue to stale-branch reconciliation after provider cancellation refusal and re-read blocked run state on later sweeps.
A workflow_run can become trusted completion evidence only when its source conclusion is success.
Cancelled, failed, skipped, action_required or otherwise non-success source runs are non-applicable completion evidence and must not cause artifact-missing failures.
Current main and the current head of an open PR remain protected from cleanup escalation.
failed_approaches: Failing the complete janitor when GitHub refuses all mutation endpoints for a legacy queued run.
Assuming every Production Release Readback workflow_run has a downloadable trusted artifact regardless of source conclusion.
